text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Trainer!
I'm all good on my break now.
choice_data_list: I see. ...Shall we get started, then?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Training for medium-distance races...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Add a training regimen tailored for 2000m and above"...
Rhein Kraft made that request to me
right after the new year began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened the day after we went to watch Cesario's race together.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer!
Give me training for medium distances!
choice_data_list: ...You want to do it now, at this time?
...You want to do it now, at this time?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I understand that shorter-distance
menus aimed at the Fillies' Revue and Oka Sho
are our top priority right now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if that's the case, you can just add it on top of that!
I'll do my absolute best...!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...When we trained together, Miss Messiah, you pulled ahead of me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And Cesario had cleanly won
a 2000m race.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "If I want to win the Oaks, I have to outrun those girls over a full 2400 meters...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
We've never aimed for races longer than a mile before, have we?
I'm... probably just lacking the experience...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Then I need to start training right away!
I have to take my time and build up experience...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please!!
I'm begging you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In fact, Rhein Kraft kept up with both the mile and medium-distance training regimens without uttering a single complaint.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Confronted by her rivals' overwhelming strength...
No, precisely because she was confronted by it,
she grit her teeth and gave it everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the single-minded determination of "winning the Triple Tiara at all costs."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah! Haa, hah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm... so sorry...
I stalled out... at the final stretch again...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
2000m. 2400m.
Running them again and again in training.
And with every run, it becomes clearer and clearer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft is—
choice_data_list: (I don't have the aptitude for longer distances...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The truth is already clear. I have to think.
From here on—what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a distance outside their aptitude, Umamusume can't
perform at their absolute best.
The Oaks, in particular, will be quite risky.
choice_data_list: Should I let them keep challenging as is...? I need to think about it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Win the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba, AND the Shuka Sho—all of them!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I will show you that I can claim
the title of "Triple Tiara"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...What comes to mind, after all, is Rhein Kraft talking so purely about that dream of hers."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It will surely come as a shock to her.
If I tell her that achieving results in the Oaks
will be difficult...
choice_data_list: Then... is it better to stay quiet?
Then... is it better to stay quiet?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No one knows the outcome of a future race.
Just because an aptitude doesn't seem to fit doesn't mean
it's decided that 'you're definitely going to lose.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft is working incredibly hard right now to win the Triple Tiara.
If that's the case, then I have to believe in her efforts and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No," I shake my head.
I scratch at my hair. —That's not it.
choice_data_list: No, that's... just giving up on thinking...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing someone into a reckless challenge without explaining the risks...
...That isn't trust."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not wanting to let her down, or not wanting to hurt her...
There's no way I can decide her future based on such cop-outs."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I remember. Falling in love with her running when I first saw it
in the mock race. And how she made
a little miracle happen in the Debut Race Selection."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her powerful run in the Make Debut.
Her dazzling performance in the Hanshin JF.
Expectations for her running and her future grew ever larger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time I saw her off and welcomed her back in the underground tunnel,
my heart pounded faster. Pure exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She can do anything."
"With those legs, she can run to the ends of the earth."
—I genuinely believed that!
choice_data_list: I'm dreaming big about Craft. So—!
I believe in the dream you hold, Craft. So—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, um...
Could we try that one more time...?
choice_data_list: Okay, I'll say it one more time. Craft—
Okay, I'll say it one more time, okay? Craft—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try to explain it as clearly and calmly as possible.
About the mismatch in aptitude.
And about how difficult challenging the Yushun Himba (Oaks) would be.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, please wait!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, I... I want to take
the Triple Tiara route...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Because it's been my dream, forever! All this time, just for this, I—!"
choice_data_list: I think there's another path out there where you can shine
I believe there's another path where you can truly shine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ngh... A shining path...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod deeply.
And then, I tell her.
choice_data_list: Let's think about it together, Craft!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
About the true futureââ
the one that Rhein Kraft should walk toward.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san...
